title: Charged-Off Settlement Plan Term Pricing Schedule
content:
**Rule.** For a Charged-Off Settlement Plan of the Hardship Assistance Programs, the term price is set by the charged-off balance of the Personal Loans loan (its unpaid principal plus unpaid fees on the decision date) and the recorded number of installments: on a charged-off balance of 2000.00 USD or more paid in two or more installments but fewer than the program's most settlement installments, the term price is the program's lump-sum settlement percent plus 3 points for every installment after the first; on a charged-off balance under 1000.00 USD paid in two or more installments the term price is the program's lump-sum settlement percent however many installments are chosen; in every other case the term price is the program's lump-sum settlement percent for a single payment and the program's installment settlement percent for two or more installments.

## Pricing schedule

| Charged-off balance | Installments recorded | Term price |
|---|---|---|
| 2000.00 USD or more | 2 or more, fewer than the program's most settlement installments | lump-sum percent plus 3 points per installment after the first |
| under 1000.00 USD | 2 or more | lump-sum percent |
| any | 1 | lump-sum percent |
| 2000.00 USD or more | equal to the program's most settlement installments | installment percent |
| 1000.00 to under 2000.00 USD | 2 or more | installment percent |

## Hypothetical figures (a lump-sum percent of 50, an installment percent of 60, a most-installments figure of 8)

- Balance 2,500.00 USD in 4 installments: 50 plus 3 points for each of 3 installments after the first, 59.
- Balance 2,500.00 USD in 8 installments: not fewer than 8, so the installment percent, 60.
- Balance 900.00 USD in 5 installments: 50.
- Balance 1,500.00 USD in 3 installments: 60.
